dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, thin, light-gray margins are visible on the distal edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers, contrasting with the dark brown-gray feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A transition boundary is visible where the uniform dark pigmentation of the crown and nape ends and the repetitive scalloped pattern of the mantle begins.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly consistent and high-contrast pale scalloping effect across the entirety of the dorsal feather tracts.
